text:
I


The blood wants to sit down.

They have stolen its reason for love.

Naked absence.

I delirium myself, I pluck myself bare.

What would the world say if God

had abandoned it like this?


II


Without you

the sun falls like an abandoned dead man.


Without you

I take myself in my arms

and carry myself to life

to beg for fervor.

translation.title: The Absent One
translation.editorial_note: The invented reflexive force of me deliro, me desplumo is echoed with self-directed verbs in English.
